intent: Test a single controlled semantic output constraint derived only from model-visible plan input: exclude REFRAME from output grammar if no issue has action_class or issue_contract. Do not change frozen original 17 cases, reference answers, model, model-visible public prompt, source control contract, decoding, other output alternatives or work IDs.

preregistered_intervention.implementation: only replace grammar root line in historical GBNF derived from frozen work_ids if and only if no issue_definition_gate activation fields are visible
preregistered_intervention.gate_active_condition: any issue has key action_class or issue_contract, regardless of oracle, category or known correct answer
preregistered_intervention.gate_active_root: root ::= execute | blocked | noopen | reframe | failclosed
preregistered_intervention.prompt: byte-identical original historical V2 prompt serialization
preregistered_intervention.single_changed_factor: admissible REFRAME output token under an observable public activation gate

frozen_analysis.primary: paired accuracy of exact status+work_id vs original actual historical baseline, 17 cases
frozen_analysis.expected_hypothesis: If the model's former 16 false REFRAME choices were caused mainly by unconstrained status choice, public gate grammar may improve actual decisions; if not, more semantic-policy limits remain.
blocked_if: invalid model pin or binary hash
grammar changes unrelated to root alternative
model inference missing for any case
